The *Dhammadesanāyaappossukkapañha* ("Why the Buddha Hesitated to Teach") is a section of the *Milindapañha* (Mil 5.5.10) [SuttaCentral]. The text deals with the traditional problem of why the Buddha, upon attaining awakening, initially showed hesitation or disinclination (*appossukka*) toward teaching the Dhamma [SuttaCentral].
